verdict.rationale: Feature flags with targeting and percentage rollouts are a fair question for analytics products, since some product-analytics platforms ship them, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Plausible offers flags, cohort or user-property targeting, or percentage rollouts. Its documented features are traffic analytics: goals, funnels, custom properties for events, filters and segments, and a read-only Stats API. None of these is a flag or rollout mechanism.
